governance.title: Consent Decision-Making Flow
governance.step1Body: The circle gathers. The need or opportunity (Driver) requiring a decision is presented.
governance.step2Body: The motivation behind the proposal is clearly explained so everyone understands the purpose.
governance.step3Body: A round dedicated exclusively to resolving questions of understanding. Not a time for opinions yet.
governance.step4Body: Each member briefly shares their thoughts and feelings about the proposal, offering perspective to the author.
governance.step5Body: The circle asks if there are any reasoned Objections (harm to the circle or impediment to progress). If none, it is agreed by consent.
governance.step6Body: The decision is recorded as agreed by consent, ready to be tested safely.

s3.title: From Pyramids to Circles
s3.intro: Traditional organizations concentrate decisions at the top. In Kanarii, authority is distributed into self-governing circles.
s3.centralDesc: One decides for others. The rest execute.

doubleLink.title: Double Linking
doubleLink.intro: To prevent circles from becoming isolated, information and influence flow in both directions through two distinct roles.
doubleLink.avoidBottlenecksDesc: For a community to work, circles need to communicate. But relying on one person as a "boss" or sole link overloads them and creates hierarchical bottlenecks.
doubleLink.directLinkDesc: Brings the vision and context of the General Circle to the local circle.
doubleLink.repLinkDesc: Brings the needs and voice of the local circle to the General Circle.
doubleLink.twoWayFlow: Two-Way Flow of Information and Influence

consentElection.title: Role Selection by Consent
consentElection.intro: No self-promotion or campaigns. We select people for roles through a transparent process built on trust.
consentElection.nominationDesc: Each person nominates someone explaining suitability based on the role domain.
consentElection.consensusDesc: The facilitator proposes a candidate and the group evaluates if there are any objections.

asynchronous.title: Asynchronous Participation & Time Windows
asynchronous.openDesc: The proposal is shared so everyone can review it at their own pace.
asynchronous.minThresholdDesc: Active members help sustain day-to-day work. Their participation counts toward the agreed threshold for decisions, while every member can still contribute questions, concerns and objections.
asynchronous.chatClarify: You can hold your response until the information is clarified in the chat.

roles.title: Roles and Levels of Involvement
roles.facilitatorDesc: Guides decision-making processes and keeps circle focus.
roles.secretaryDesc: Custodians circle memory, agreements and documentation.
roles.timekeeperDesc: Monitors energy and respect for agreed timelines.
roles.activeMemberDesc: Active members help sustain day-to-day work. Their participation counts toward the agreed threshold for decisions, while every member can still contribute questions, concerns and objections.

crossing.title: Connecting Offerings and Needs
